zh.title: 民航局舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇 聚焦國際發展與安全規範
zh.summary: 民航局23日舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇，邀國外民航機關及專家分享經驗。
body: 交通部民用航空局11月23日舉辦「2026國際無人機及先進空中交通論壇」，議題涵蓋國際無人機與先進空中交通（AAM）發展，以及國際航空安全規範。
民航局表示，論壇邀請國外民航主管機關與專家分享實務經驗，期望藉此促進臺灣無人機產業及相關制度與國際接軌。
民航局指出，電動垂直起降航空器（eVTOL）等新興技術，未來有機會拓展都市與區域運輸、緊急救援及偏遠地區交通服務。先進空中交通從技術研發走向實際營運，仍須建立適航認證、安全監理與空域整合機制。

en.title: Taiwan CAA hosts drone and advanced air mobility forum on development and safety
en.summary: Taiwan CAA hosts a drone and advanced air mobility forum on Nov. 23, inviting overseas experts.
body: The 2026 international forum on drones and advanced air mobility (AAM), organized by Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA), began on Nov. 23. Its topics include international drone and AAM development and international aviation safety rules.

The CAA said it invited overseas civil aviation authorities and experts to share practical experience. It hopes the sharing will help Taiwan’s drone industry and related systems align with international practices.

The agency said emerging technologies such as electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft (eVTOL) could eventually expand urban and regional transport, emergency rescue and services to remote areas. It said AAM’s transition from research to operations still requires airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration mechanisms.
